title: Cancellation through source and target isomorphisms
statement: In any category, if e and d are isomorphisms and e.hom ≫ u ≫ d.hom = e.hom ≫ v ≫ d.hom, then u = v.

source.place: The standard cancellation properties of isomorphism morphisms.

proof.text: Cancel the source isomorphism using epi cancellation, then cancel the target isomorphism using mono cancellation; reassociate the displayed equality.

proof_origin.place: Iso.hom is an isomorphism and therefore both epi and mono.

mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Iso provides the cancellation API used by the proof.
The standard epi and mono cancellation lemmas are available.
